title: Removing a fixed pseudo-effective anticanonical error
exact_target: Let S be smooth connected projective complex and let $L=-K_S$ carry a smooth semipositive Hermitian metric. For any pseudo-effective Cartier divisor D, if $H^{0}(S,m_j$ $L-D)\neq 0$ for a strictly increasing sequence of positive $m_j$, must $H^{0}(S,kL)\neq 0$ for some positive k?
